title: Jumia Nigeria Products Scraper Input
description: Configure the Jumia Nigeria scraper. Provide a category or search URL to extract product data including prices, ratings, and reviews.

start_url.title: Start URL
start_url.description: Jumia Nigeria category or search URL to scrape products from.

results_wanted.title: Maximum Products
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of products to extract. The scraper will automatically paginate to collect this many products.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for avoiding blocks. Residential proxies are recommended for Jumia.
